Reference-app brief

Build a cohesive reference application that demonstrates: - portfolio or application home - case overview - visible route - stage workspace - inherited fields with provenance - evidence packet - decision review - append-only timeline - superseded values - final readable artifact - mobile composition The same shell must support project, change, and consulting domains by changing vocabulary, data, and module emphasis rather than rebuilding the interface.
